title: Full Software playback without cross-origin isolation

definition.hypothesis: Existing cooperative mpv can be extended to finite-file software video plus consumed-audio feedback without shared memory.
definition.scope_contract: Investigate and run renderer prerequisites; plan a bounded real-media Software prototype.
definition.baseline: Existing isolated Software with the same media; reuse verified private mpv infrastructure.
definition.success_criteria: See README: actual reference pictures/audio, A/V timing, seek, cancellation and cleanup; renderer screen is a narrower gate.
definition.stop_criteria: Unsafe reentry/scheduling, unbounded queues, or inability to satisfy the declared workload without weakening fidelity.
definition.primary_metric: Additional correctly qualified playback capability without isolation.
definition.negative_control: Shared memory forbidden; JSPI absent in Asyncify; invalid render size rejected.
definition.effort_limit: Source review and one two-backend renderer lifecycle prerequisite; no codec rebuild/media implementation or benchmark.

define.basis: Source-grounded finite Software prototype contract and explicit investigation boundary.

prepare.basis: Verified private dependencies/SDK; copied and hashed source inputs; generated two renderer prerequisite binaries. No media fixture preparation claim.

screen.basis: Source audit and two-backend idle renderer lifecycle passed, three cycles each.

correctness.basis: Actual media decode, canvas output, audio and A/V lifecycle untested.

performance.basis: Requires a declared workload and passing media correctness first.

results.basis: Commands, build records, browser outcomes, source snapshots and hashes retained.

decision.basis: Pursue a bounded real-media private Software prototype; no production qualification.

current_decision.scope: Private Software finite-file prototype; RGB first, synchronized stereo A/V next
current_decision.rationale: Existing private mpv accepts the full native RGB renderer lifecycle; missing codec/worker/transport integration is concrete.
current_decision.next_action: Build a separate MPEG-2 private playback profile and verify video-only decode, presentation and seeks on both runtimes.

next_action: Build a separate MPEG-2 private playback profile and verify video-only decode, presentation and seeks on both runtimes.
